title: Supply Held Back after a Prescription Renewal on Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy
content:
**Tailwise Pharmacy note — renewals and the pet's recheck**

A recently renewed prescription holds back days from the planned supply days of an Autoship Pharmacy or Autoship Compounded Pharmacy shipment under Tailwise Autoship until the pet's recheck. The origin of the linked prescription (whether it came to the pharmacy as a renewal) and the date its authorization was recorded are read from the Tailwise Pharmacy prescription on file.

| Linked prescription | Authorization recorded, days before the re-set | Days held back |
|---|---|---|
| Came as a renewal | no more than 90 | 21 |
| Came as a renewal | more than 90 but no more than 180 | 7 |
| Came as a renewal | more than 180 | none |
| Not a renewal | any | none |

The age of the authorization is the number of calendar days from the date it was recorded to the day of the re-set.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical renewals)

- Authorization recorded 90 days before the re-set: 21 days held back.
- Recorded 91 days before: 7 days held back.
- Recorded 180 days before: 7 days held back.
- Recorded 181 days before: no days held back.
- A prescription that came to the pharmacy other than as a renewal, recorded 10 days before: no days held back.
